That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!What you'll doBuild and ship with AIYou will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.Talk to our usersYou will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.Find the right problems to solveIn a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.Own your work end to endFrom shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.What you should haveYou have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.You work well without an office around you. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
description_clean:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in France.
In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.
Accountabilities

Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

Requirements

Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

Strongly preferred:

Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

Nice to have:

Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.
Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.
Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.
Benefits

Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.
Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.
100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.
Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development.
Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.
Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.
AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.
Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.
Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.

Senior Backend Developer
description_clean: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.Why this role existsEvery market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.What you will ownBackend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.How we workWe are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.Your first yearIn your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.Who we are looking forYou have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.English is your working language. German is a plus.What makes you stand outYou have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.The teamWe are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.The factsLocation: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia teamRole: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadershipReporting line: Our Lead EngineersStack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolithPensum: 100%Start: As soon as possibleLanguage: English; German a plusProcess: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference callsHow to applyApply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. title: Senior Product Designer
description_clean: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.About AIHRFounded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.Why a designer nowWe built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.Role and ResponsibilitiesAs our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.Journeys and engagementMap and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.Growth surfacesDesign the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.Craft and UI ownershipYou don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.Design system and enablementOwn our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.How you workYou're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.On a typical weekOn Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.We offerA key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;Competitive, benchmarked compensation;The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;Flexible working hours & working from home arrangementsA high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;Pension plan;5 Mental health days per year;Access to OpenUp mental health platform;Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;Free access to the office gym.Apply for the jobAre you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.   Who you areYou're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around  you. You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

About the role
Are you an experienced Software Engineer who loves writing code, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers become better at what they do?
At Pigment, our Engineering Managers are engineers first.
Unlike traditional Engineering Manager positions, this role is designed for someone who wants to remain deeply involved in building software while taking on meaningful people-management responsibilities.

Write, review, refactor and ship production code regularly using React, TypeScript and JavaScript.


Design and build sophisticated user interfaces for interacting with large datasets, including filtering, visualisation and complex configuration.


Take ownership of engineering tasks and features from technical design through implementation, testing and deployment.

Coach and mentor engineers, sharing technical knowledge and helping them improve their problem-solving abilities.


Hold regular 1:1 meetings with your direct reports to discuss progress, challenges and career development.


Provide constructive feedback, recognise achievements and support individual development plans.


Help engineers establish clear goals and understand the skills required to progress.


Support performance reviews and development discussions, including more challenging conversations when necessary.


Work alongside Tech Leads to understand engineers' technical contributions and development needs.


Help foster a collaborative engineering culture where people continuously learn from one another.

You're an engineer first, with a genuine interest in developing people.

Previous formal people-management experience is a plus, but not a requirement. We're equally interested in strong Senior Engineers who have demonstrated the ability to coach others and are ready to take the next step.
Our interview process
Because Engineering Managers at Pigment spend approximately 80% of their time coding, they go through the same core technical assessments as our Software Engineers.
We want you to understand these expectations from the beginning.
1️⃣  Technical Screen
A technical discussion including a 15-minute code refactoring exercise.
AI assistance is not permitted during the refactoring exercise.
2️⃣  Live Coding
A hands-on algorithmic coding interview focused on problem-solving, code quality and technical reasoning.
AI assistance is not permitted.
3️⃣  System Design
A discussion exploring your approach to designing software systems, evaluating technical trade-offs and solving complex engineering problems.
4️⃣  Final Interview with the EML (Engineering Manager Lead)
A conversation exploring your motivation, engineering mindset, approach to coaching and alignment with Pigment's culture and expectations.
Important: Our Engineering Managers are assessed against the same senior technical engineering standards as our Software Engineers. This is a role for people who genuinely enjoy coding and want to keep doing it.

You'll probably love this role if:


You enjoy writing code more than spending your day in management meetings.

You enjoy the challenge of balancing meaningful individual contributions with coaching responsibilities.

title: Product Designer
description_clean:
Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...How you'll help us achieve it
We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers!
In this role, you'll:

Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature.
Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma).
Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.
Contribute to Wave's design system and component library.
Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.
Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs. 
Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution (Wave uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks).

Key details

This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.
You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you'll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You're highly encouraged to visit market counties more often! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year.
Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package.
Major benefits:

Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays
$10,000 annual charitable donation matching



Requirements

Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps
Fluency in English. French language skills are a plus. 
At least 6 years of end-to-end in-house experience, with a consumer focus on product design with mobile apps.
Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with an eye at removing friction from flows
Attention to detail and high level of visual craft
Strong illustration and animation skills. We use After Effects and Lottie at Wave but anything that can be converted to a Lottie file works
Ability to deliver high-quality designs with speed and polish
Bias towards action. Identify UX improvements without waiting for the perfect conditions
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Ability to think through complex interaction design as well as thinking about tradeoffs of each solution
Curiosity for understanding and unpacking customer behaviors and needs
Experience balancing business goals, customer needs, and technical tradeoffs, while explaining your point of view to the team

You might be a good fit if you

Are detail-oriented and able to balance multiple projects
Can iterate separate concepts quickly to user test design bets. The ability to move fast and update designs based on customer feedback is an important quality we're looking for
Think carefully about in-the-weeds details and their role within the design system
Feel comfortable anticipating and designing for edge cases
Enjoy pairing with designers, engineers, and product managers
Are excited to learn about how all our products work together
Can speak, read, and write in French. This is nice to have but not a strong requirement - we have large markets in West Africa where French will come in handy.
Our team

We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Chez Theodo FinTech, notre mission est de rendre la finance plus utile pour les gens, les entreprises et la société. Entité experte en FinTech de Theodo, nous accompagnons nos clients -  des grandes entreprises, des ScaleUps et des StartUps du secteur des services financiers - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société.
 
En tant qu'experts technologiques dans les services financiers, Theodo FinTech livre en un temps record des produits digitaux exceptionnels avec zéro bug et un haut niveau de sécurité. Nous savons intégrer les API de toutes les plateformes fintech B2B pour créer des solutions de finance embarquée.Ton équipe :
Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.
 
Tes futures missions :
En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo FinTech, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.
 
Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement.
 
Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo FinTech :


Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements


 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

BPI France : En mars 2020, en pleine crise Covid, Theodo conçoit et déploie en 5 jours la plateforme des Prêts Garantis par l’État (PGE). Sécurisée, scalable dès le lancement et accessible à toutes les banques françaises sans formation, elle a permis de piloter en temps réel le dispositif et de soutenir le déploiement de 115 milliards d’euros de prêts dans l’économie française.
Nickel : Pour accélérer la diversification de son offre, l’entreprise lance un mini-crédit 100 % digital intégré à son application, en partenariat avec Floa. En seulement 5 mois (dont 11 semaines pour la V1), une équipe de 5 experts Fintech Theodo conçoit et déploie l’offre, malgré une intégration API complexe et de fortes dépendances internes. Résultat : un parcours fluide mêlant natif et webview, permettant à Nickel d’augmenter la rétention et l’ARPU tout en restant fidèle à sa promesse d’inclusion financière.

 
Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python… 
 
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :


Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc


 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.



Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur
Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming)
Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech
Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique
Tu fais preuve d’exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka)
Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S)
Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative



 
Le processus de recrutement :


Un premier call de 30 minutes avec un recruteur
Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur
Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs
Un exercice en direct de debuging
Un entretien dirigeant de 30 minutes pour revenir sur tes motivations à rejoindre Theodo et répondre à tes derniers questions

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo FinTech ?
L’environnement:
💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.
🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…)
🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel
 
Le package :
📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe
💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor

🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…)
🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...)

🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an
🩺 Une mutuelle Alan (accès à de la médecine douce et téléconsultation)
🍽 Des titres restaurants de 10 euros via Swile.

Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.
That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.
You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.
What you'll be doing

Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

title: Tech Lead (m/f/d)
description_clean:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.
This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product
Who We Want
A strong, current backend engineer.You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.
Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.
Ready to lead people.You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow
Strong at delivery.You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.
Product-minded.You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way.
Clear communicator.You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people 
Excited about AI-assisted development.You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.
Who We Don’t Want
Pure people manager. 
You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.
Hero engineer. 
You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.
Pure delivery manager. 
You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.
Remote-only operator. 
You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.
Your Day To Day

Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.
Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.
Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.
Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.
Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.
Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.
Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.
Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.

You will regulary disccuss the direction of architecture with the CTO and product with the CPO
Why People Choose Us
Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics
Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable
Modern stack. Kotlin/Quarkus, AWS, TypeScript/React/Next.js, and LangGraph for AI-powered features
Squad-based organization. Each squad owns its domain end-to-end with real ownership and autonomy
Two clear career tracks. We support both individual contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Management Paths with explicit reversibility between both and Tech Lead being the first level of management that is still quite hands-on
Product-led structure. PMs report directly to the CPO, keeping product strategy focused, consistent, and clearly prioritized
Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup
Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
Regular company and team events
Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth

description_clean:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 
 
Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. 
 
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred.
 
Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! 
Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.
Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.
Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.
Tes futures missions :
Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.
En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet

Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :



Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA

Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes




Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe


Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien




Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe


Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)



Les problématiques sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolution :
2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
Solution Architect: participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
Managériale : Engineering Manager

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement
Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes missions
La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.
Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.
Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.
Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer
Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.
Concrètement :

Avant-vente : traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée, et convaincre le client que c’est la plus ingénieuse pour le projet.
Déploiement : infrastructure as code, de bout en bout.
Audit : conformité HDS et bonnes pratiques des standards Cloud.
Développement d’assets : agents, boilerplates, projets open source.

À plus long terme, nous voulons t’impliquer dans la structuration des offres et des équipes Theodo.
Autonome sur ton expertise, fort en équipe
Sur l'architecture Cloud, tu dois pouvoir être autonome. C'est ton domaine, tu le pilotes.
Mais tu ne travailles jamais seul. En avant-vente, tu fais équipe avec l'Account Manager et le Solution Architect. En projet, tu collabores avec l'Engineering Manager et les autres DevOps. La collaboration est au centre de chaque mission.
 
L'équipe que tu rejoins
Theodo est certifié infogéreur HDS. Nous avons développé notre propre framework de mise en conformité, et assurons la maintenance HDS d'une vingtaine d'applications en production.

Ton manager : Ludovic Descateaux, Group Manager de Theodo Healthtech.
En avant-vente : un binôme Account Manager (ex. Marine Accolas) et Solution Architect.
En projet : un Engineering Manager (ex. Thomas Walter).
L'équipe Run HDS, riche de plus de 50 projets, t'épaule sur les architectures.
Tu participes aux guildes Sécu, DevOps, Agentique, et aux rituels hebdomadaires de formation.

Tes perspectives d'évolution (moyen / long terme)

Business : Partnership, avec la responsabilité d'une plateforme business et/ou d'une practice du groupe.
Managériale : Group Manager.

 
Profil recherché
Expériences

6 à 14 ans d'expérience.
Une expertise en infrastructure Cloud.
Une expérience en service (ESN ou conseil).
Nice to have : Une expérience dans la santé et des notions de réglementation HDS.

Compétences clés

Concevoir des architectures qui accélèrent le développement tout en respectant la réglementation.
Traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée aux contraintes du client.
Utiliser les agents LLM de façon structurée pour améliorer la qualité du code.
Présenter et convaincre sur la pertinence d'une solution.
Maîtriser Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes, ArgoCD et un cloud public (AWS / GCP / Azure / Scaleway).

Le process de recrutement

Call de qualification (30 min) avec un·e Talent Acquisition Manager.
Entretien fit (1h).
Test technique infra (1h).
Entretien avant-vente (1h).
Entretien dirigeant (1h).
Prises de référence, notamment avec des managers précédents.

 
Mots clés :
Medtech, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 27001, MDR, Dispositif Medical, Health Data Hub,
DevOps, Cloud, Terraform, AWS, GCP, Azure, OVH, Scaleway

💼 Un groupe de 700 personnes, avec de vraies possibilités d'évolution cross-entités. 🤝 Un coach interne dédié, avec des séances hebdomadaires sur ton quotidien et ta carrière. 🎯 Des projets associatifs via la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…). 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d'entreprise annuel.

title: Business Development Intern
description_clean: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more.How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?At Urban Connect, we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility.To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibilityWant to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.How you will make a differenceTurn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.What you bringAn excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.What you can expectHigh standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow.We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.A view of the whole business.You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.Direct access and room to take initiative.Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.The opportunity to build a future with us.If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.You will also benefit from:Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!Ready to make a difference?Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself?We look forward to meeting you.Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.
Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.
This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.
We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:
At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:
In this role, you will:

Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.


 Your Profile:

5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.
Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
Fluent English required
